intent: Show the substantial rise in the contraceptive use rate between 1975 and 2019, driven by distribution reaching remote areas.

requirements.question: How did contraceptive use change from 1975 to 2019?
Are all data marks declared by G0 present in the required state or states?

scope.selection: all data rows (table has no role column)

units.claim: Contraceptive use rose from 8% in 1975 to 76% in 2019 - a 68-percentage-point (9.5x) increase.
accept: a single bar growing from 8% to 76%
reject: only the 2019 value with no change
units.evidence: The single bar animates from 8% to 76% (or both endpoints are shown).

units.claim: Every declared state shows all required bar marks or stacked segments: 1975=1, 2019=1.
accept: all 2 required data marks are visible
every declared state shows its complete required mark set
reject: omitting any required bar or stacked segment
replacing missing marks with a summary total or subtitle
units.evidence: G0 data-row coverage is rendered as a complete set of identifiable bar marks.

optional_valid: The cause named in the narration: distribution reaching remote areas

g0_data_completeness.selection: all data rows (table has no role column)
